attempts.text:
SHAGUN SUHANI 
CMA (Qualified) | Management Accounting | Financial Reporting | Budgeting & Forecasting | Variance Analysis | 
Reconciliations                                                                                                 Contact no.: 8809723255 

Email: suhanishagun3@gmail.com 
Uttam Nagar, Delhi 

CAREER SUMMARY 
CMA-qualified finance professional with 3 years of experience in financial reporting, accounting, budgeting, forecasting, internal controls, risk 
assessment, audit support and management accounting. Experienced in preparing financial statements, reconciliations, month-end reporting, 
statutory compliance and working with internal and external auditors. Proficient in Advanced Excel, Tally Prime and financial analysis with strong 
attention to detail, analytical thinking and stakeholder collaboration. 

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 
Storyloom Solutions Private Limited (Finance & Accounting Intern)                                                                                  Sept 2024 – June 2026 

 Assisted in financial reporting, budgeting and forecasting by analysing actual performance against budgets and identifying key variances.  
 Reviewed and reconciled 50+ financial and corporate documents to support due diligence, audit readiness, risk assessment and financial 

reporting.  
 Supported preparation of investor reports and financial documentation ensuring data accuracy and regulatory compliance.  
 Worked closely with internal stakeholders to strengthen reporting quality and internal financial controls.  

Patel Agri Industries Private Limited (CMA Trainee)                                                                                                        March 2023 – June 2024 
 Performed production accounting, financial accounting and cost analysis to improve operational efficiency. 
 Prepared accurate financial statements and accounting records in accordance with Accounting Standards while supporting month-end and 

year-end reporting. 
 Assisted in maintaining internal financial control systems, reconciliations and accounting processes to ensure accuracy and compliance. 
 Maintained GST compliance for 40+ entities by performing return filings, reconciliations, and regulatory reporting, ensuring accurate 

financial records and adherence to statutory requirements. 
 Filed 50+ income tax returns for individuals, firms, and companies with precise direct tax computation and reconciliation. 
 Supervised and reviewed the work of 6 junior trainees, ensuring accuracy, discipline, and on-time delivery in a controlled accounting 

environment. 
 

EDUCATION 

 
KEY SKILLS 

  Financial Reporting 
 Financial Statement Analysis 
 Internal Financial Controls 
 Risk Assessment and Risk Mitigation 
 Stakeholder Management 
 Month-end Close and Quarter-end Close 
 Cross-functional Collaboration 
 Advanced Excel (Pivot Tables, Xlookup/Vlookup, Sumifs, If) 

 

 Statutory & Tax Audit Coordination 
 Production & Cost Accounting 
 Budgeting & Forecasting 
 Accounting Standards (AS) & Basic Understanding of IFRS 
 Management Accounting & MIS Reporting 
 MCA/ROC Filings & Company Incorporation 
 Tally Prime 
 Problem Solving and Time Management 

CERTIFICATIONS AND ACHIEVEMENTS 
 Advanced Skills Training and Industry Oriented Training – ICMAI  
 Cleared CMA Intermediate and CMA Foundation in first attempt  
 Secured exemption in Law, Strategic Cost Management, and CMAD in CMA Final  
 Awarded 1st Prize in Singing Competition  
 Completed SAP Training conducted by ICMAI 
 Selected among Top 3 participants in Group Discussion (Radio Snehi)  

COURSE YEAR INSTITUTION MARKS REMARKS 

CMA Final June/ Dec 2025 The Institute of Cost 
Accountants of India (ICMAI) 

53.75% Exemption in 3 papers 

CMA Intermediate June 2022 52.50% Cleared both groups in the first attempt 

B. Com.(H) 2020-2024 DAV College, Siwan 72.38% Distinction in 5 papers 

CMA Foundation June 2020 ICMAI 70.25% Cleared in the first attempt 

Class XII  Mar 2020 DAV College, Siwan 86.40% Distinction in all papers 

Class X - CBSE Mar 2018 MSVM, Siwan 87.60% Class topper out of a batch of 160
